skill.name: Script Loading Control
skill.description: Use Next.js Script component to manage loading strategy and execution timing of third-party scripts. Prevents blocking the main thread and optimizes script execution order when integrating external scripts.
skill.skill_body:
Apply the Next.js Script component to third-party scripts. Configure the loading strategy (e.g., async, defer, or on-demand) to ensure scripts do not block page rendering. Verify that the page remains interactive during script loading.

## Objective

control third-party script loading and execution timing
## Applicable Signals

- third-party script integration required
- page interactivity during script load is a concern
- script execution order matters

## Contraindications

- script is critical for initial page render
- using inline scripts that must execute synchronously
- script has no external dependencies and must run before page interaction

## Workflow Steps

- Identify the third-party script and its execution requirements
- Select appropriate loading strategy (async, defer, or on-demand)
- Wrap script in Next.js Script component with chosen strategy
- Verify page remains interactive during script loading
- Monitor script execution order and dependencies

## Constraints

- Script component must be used instead of native <script> tags for optimization benefits
- Loading strategy must be explicitly chosen based on script criticality

## Cautions

- Verify that deferred or async scripts do not cause race conditions with dependent code
- Test page interactivity metrics to confirm non-blocking behavior

## Output Contract

- Third-party scripts load asynchronously without blocking the main thread
- Page remains interactive during script loading
- Script execution timing is controlled and predictable
